name: custom-paste-image
description: Paste a clipboard image straight into a markdown file, with configurable target folder and link style. Reads real image files (not just bitmaps), keeps PNG transparency, and works on Windows, Remote-WSL, and Linux.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Images are written with the file system API and linked by path, so the document has to live on disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: customPasteImage.folder can point outside the workspace, so its workspace value is ignored until you trust the folder.

customPasteImage.folder.markdownDescription: Where to save the image. Empty saves next to the edited file. A path starting with `/` is relative to the workspace folder root (e.g. `/assets/img`). Anything else is relative to the edited file's directory (e.g. `images` or `../assets`).

enumDescriptions: Link relative to the edited file, e.g. ./images/name.png

Link relative to the workspace root with a leading /, e.g. /assets/img/name.png — useful for static sites that serve a folder at the site root. Falls back to relative when the image isn't saved inside the workspace.
customPasteImage.linkStyle.description: How the inserted link is written.

customPasteImage.confirmFileName.description: Ask for the file name before saving. The suggested name comes from the copied file, the selected text, or the current time.

enumDescriptions: — lets you set a size
customPasteImage.format.description: What to insert into the document.
